verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static Microsoft Graph API reference pages for OneDrive endpoints, such as driveItem, createLink, search and delta. None of it mentions an interactive explorer, a try-it console or runnable examples. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at the checked paths, so nothing evidences the interactive or runnable part of the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
